description: Mayor of London & Gnewt Cargo Electric Vehicle Trial is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. The Mayor of London and Gnewt Cargo secured funding from Innovate UK in 2017 to run a commercial electric vehicle trial. The trial ran until the end of December 2019 and evaluated the performance, impact and commercial viability of using electric vehicles for last-mile deliveries in central London. Find out more about the trial here. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 9 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
